names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Νικόλαος Καραμάνος ο Νεομάρτυρας», with the rank words left off. The same page gives «Νικόλαος Καραμάνος ή Κασσέτης», so the second surname Κασσέτης is an alternative the page records and is not drafted as a separate form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 6. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученик Никола Караман.“ — with «Свети» (“saint”) and «мученик» (the `martyr` grade `types` keeps) left off, which leaves the forename and the surname. «Никола» is not the «Николај» the other entry of this day gives the archbishop of Myra and does not fold with it, and «Караман» is the surname saint.gr prints as Καραμάνος; the Serbian form is a letter shorter and is copied as the book has it, not adjusted to the Greek. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Νεομάρτυς Νικόλαος Καραμάνος ή Κασσέτης, γεννήθηκε το έτος 1623 μ.Χ.», with the page's own head «(1623 - 1657)».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Νικόλαος Καραμάνος ο Νεομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The 19 March in the page's text is the day of his martyrdom and not a second feast: the page gives it as «στις 19 Μαρτίου του έτους 1657 μ.Χ., (Μεγάλη Πέμπτη) και ώρα 9 το πρωί», names no commemoration on it, and heads the entry as fixed on 6 December. The page prints no hymn. The corpus's other new martyrs of this name are other men: Nicholas the Grocer of Karpenisi is 1657 - 1672 and kept on 23 September, and nothing here joins this one to any of them. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.12.2025 (6. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Никола Караман.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: the heading’s «мученик» is the plain `martyr` grade, and the folder holds `new-martyr`, which is the fuller reading saint.gr states outright («ο Νεομάρτυρας») and which this book’s own 1657 confirms — nothing was downgraded on a shorter rank word. `dates` UNTOUCHED and the year AGREES: «обешен у Смирни 1657. године», hanged at Smyrna in 1657, which is the `attested` 1657 the folder already carries off saint.gr; the book gives no year of birth, so the 1406-style head figure — here 1623 — stands alone as it did. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS IS THE PLACE AND THE MANNER: Smyrna, and hanging after being bitterly tortured by the Turks for the faith of Christ, where saint.gr gives the hour and the day of the week and this book gives neither. NO `locations`: Smyrna is named and the folder has never held a coordinate, and a single city for a man with no other place in his dossier is not worth a point this reader cannot source to a gazetteer. NO `related` row: the entry names nobody. A DISCREPANCY NOT RESOLVED AND NOT MINE: saint.gr dates his martyrdom to 19 March 1657 and yet the Greek calendar keeps him on 6 December, which is also this book’s day; both calendars are recorded as they stand. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
